message3: Suggested target = average gross units sold per day × lead days (rounded up) + safety units. Reorder subtracts sellable stock and open purchase orders. Review seasonality and supplier availability before ordering; nothing is purchased automatically.
message4: Age bands estimate FIFO from tracked receipt movements across all boxes. Transfers do not restart age. Untracked opening stock, count increases and returned units have unknown age. Age totals include damaged stock; these are estimates, not batch-level tracking.
